copy.title: Surelok Locksmiths — Home of Your Local Surelok Branch
copy.description: Surelok Locksmiths is a family of nine local branches helping people feel settled and safe at home — new keys on moving day, upgrades for growing families, and a calm response when things go wrong.
copy.topbar: New home? Change the locks on day one — your local Surelok can do it while you unpack
copy.eyebrow: For Homes & the People In Them
copy.lead: Moving day, a new baby, a teenager's first key, an elderly parent living alone — the moments that change how you think about your front door. Surelok's nine branches, from the North Downs to the Potteries, exist for exactly those moments.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches across England — each one a local team, not a call centre.

coverage.heading: A Surelok branch near you
coverage.intro: Every branch is its own local team with its own number — the person who answers is the person who comes out. The neighbourhoods listed are where they're working this week.
coverage.areaPattern: Looking after homes in {areas} and across {town}

services.heading: The jobs that make a house feel like yours
services.intro: Most of our work isn't an emergency — it's the sensible hour that stops one ever happening.
featured: The moving-day essential: every previous keyholder locked out by teatime, one set of keys, all yours.
Insurance-standard locks fitted to front, back and side doors — explained in plain English, not jargon.
Child-safe, insurer-happy window locks for family homes, fixed or fitted in a single visit.
Tired locks upgraded before winter, before a holiday, or just before you stop trusting them.
It happens to every household eventually. Calm, non-destructive entry — no drama, no lecture.
24/7 cover for the nights that don't go to plan, from the same local team you'd call in daylight.

why.heading: Why families keep our number
why.intro: Nine branches, one habit: treating every house call like it's our own mum's front door.
points: Book us for completion day and the locks are changed before the kettle's found. It's our most-loved service for a reason.
We explain what we're doing and why, quote before we start, and never upsell hardware a home doesn't need.
Branches are small local teams — the locksmith who fitted your locks is the one who answers when you call back.
Every Surelok engineer is DBS-checked, ID-carrying and insured. You're letting them into your home; we take that seriously.

cta.heading: Moving soon — or just never got round to it?
cta.sub: Find your local Surelok branch and get it sorted in one visit.

copy.footerBlurb: The home of Surelok Locksmiths — nine local branches helping households across England settle in safe, from moving-day lock changes to 24/7 emergency cover.
